# dgVoodoo2

`DDraw.dll` and `D3DImm.dll` in this folder are dgVoodoo2 2.87.5 by Dege, unmodified
(<https://dege.fw.hu/>, <https://github.com/dege-diosg/dgVoodoo2>). dgVoodoo2 translates
the game's DirectDraw 7 / Direct3D 7 calls to modern graphics APIs; `build.py` copies the
two libraries next to `Locoland.exe`, and their settings are in `game/dgVoodoo.conf`.

dgVoodoo2 is not part of OpenLocoland and is not covered by its licence. Its readme allows
shipping "a game or game mod with unmodified individual dgVoodoo components"; all rights to
dgVoodoo2 stay with its author. The full package, with the control panel
(`dgVoodooCpl.exe`) for experimenting with settings, is available from the links above.
